history.summary: Freehold 775 sqft '1BR' (likely 1+study/dual-key given the size) in a shoebox-dominated Geylang block, listed at $1,160 PSF — roughly the URA median and below the ~$1,715 current 12-month average, but the development shows a negative 6.1% appreciation over 62 txns. The discounted entry can't offset a genuinely deteriorating price trend and shoebox/locale headwinds.
history.rating_rationale: URA shows -6.1% annual appreciation over a meaningful 62 txns — this development is losing value, the strongest possible negative signal. Web data confirms a shoebox-heavy mix with mixed reviews ('shoebox size') and a Geylang locale that carries resale stigma. Although $1,160 PSF looks cheap vs a ~$1,715 average, the bigger 775 sqft format and the falling-price trend make this a poor 5-7yr investment.
red_flags: Negative -6.1% appreciation over 62 txns — value actively declining
Shoebox-dominated development with Geylang locale stigma
775 sqft as a '1BR' is an awkward format for resale

history.summary: Genuinely cheap freehold SOHO/penthouse unit in Geylang, but the discount partly reflects the Geylang vice-belt stigma and a niche product format. Real value, real caveats.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,160 psf for the 775 sqft '1-BR Penthouse + Home Office' format vs a verified comparable 775 sqft transaction at $1,050k / $1,355 psf (May 2025) and a project 12-month avg of ~$1,479-1,715 psf. That is a ~15% discount to its own-size recent comps, so the algo's very_low_psf flag and -38.3% age-adj premium are corroborated by real transactions, not a mis-scrape. Freehold is not itself a forward edge (v3.4), but the verified intra-project discount on a deep 62-txn appreciation base is the buy case. Held to medium confidence (not high) because psf_cohort_txns=2 is thin and the discount may encode a weaker stack/facing or the Geylang owner-occupier/financing discount rather than pure mispricing.
red_flags: Geylang (D14) location carries vice-belt stigma, weaker owner-occupier demand and financing restrictions in parts of the area, which depresses both exit liquidity and the discount's reliability
Niche SOHO / 1-BR-penthouse-plus-home-office product (only 29 such units) is a thin sub-market with fewer natural buyers
psf_cohort_txns=2 — own-size band is shallow; the discount could be stack/facing-specific
Trailing 5yr appreciation is negative (-5.0%); momentum offers no support
275-unit project but the large-format stack is small and less liquid
catalysts: Verified ~15% discount to its own 775 sqft recent transaction ($1,160 vs $1,355 psf)
Freehold tenure plus full facilities (pools, gym) is rare in the price band, supporting downside floor
Walkable to Dakota CC8 / Aljunied EW9; Paya Lebar Central commercial rejuvenation nearby

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: SOHO/large 1-BR format in Geylang rents to a value tenant pool; the freehold+facilities mix supports a workable yield but the niche layout caps rental upside. Adequate, not a draw.
